audit_items.proof_trace: The property assumes a dedup set exists that might skip verification for repeated commitments. However, the code performs NO commitment-level deduplication: validate_data_columns (kzg_utils.rs:68-79) adds ALL commitments to vectors, verify_cell_proof_batch (lib.rs:266-270) groups only by column_index and verifies ALL items. The only deduplication is at sidecar level (slot, proposer, index), not commitment level.
